method_notes: Lambeth community schools (LA as admission authority): distance is a straight line measured by a computerised mapping system from a point at the home address identified via the Local Land and Property Gazetteer (LLPG) to a central point in the school's grounds as profiled in the software. Closest-first tie-breaker; equal distances resolved by random allocation (Synergy). Exceptions: Henry Cavendish (two sites) uses nodal points (Balham: Hydethorpe Road; Streatham: Dingley Lane); Sudbourne has a different proximity point (measured from the Mandrell Road site per brochure); Kingswood measured to the upper site. Own-admission-authority schools vary: Christ Church Streatham (pedestrian gate), St Leonard's (pupil gate), St Luke's (Linton Grove entrance), Corpus Christi (main reception entrance), Dunraven (North Site entrance), Rosendale (central point as council). Walking routes are used by Iqra (walking distance), Orchard (safest walking route) and Julian's (shortest walking route). All 'last distance' columns in the community allocation tables are headed 'Last distance - straight line (metres)'. Sources: Determined 2026-27 Lambeth school admissions arrangements (criterion 5, p.7-8) and the 2026-27 primary admissions brochure.

gaps: Postcodes are from the 2026-27 Lambeth primary brochure (GIAS was not reachable); Kings Avenue (2024 only) has no postcode. Per-school source_url points to the 2026 document; 2025/2024 figures come from the matching year's document for the same school type (Streatham Wells and Oasis Johanna/South Bank 2024 are in the 2024 community PDF). The 2026 community PDF has garbled column text for several rows (Jessop, Jubilee, Stockwell, Sudbourne, Telferscot, Walnut Tree Walk, Woodmansterne), but each last-distance figure was legible. Some published figures are suspect: Iqra's distances are labelled 'miles' (almost certainly metres); St Andrew's Catholic has no unit; Dunraven (2492.08), Reay (696.8) and Woodmansterne (979.49) are identical in 2026 and 2025; Telferscot 2024 is 819.64 in the Nov 2024 reissue vs 173.63 in the April 2024 original. 'all_offered' means the council printed 'All applicants received a place at the school or a higher preferred offer' (no distance published). Faith-school policies were not individually researched beyond the council publications; secondary-only and special schools are excluded.
